Tactical Tasks List: 114 of 152 open rows (75%) are now past their per-status staleness threshold. Oldest: 149 days, 'Call For Balance (Naqib)'. Top 39 shown individually by age; remaining 75 rolled into one item. This backlog has been flagged repeatedly since 2026-07-31 -- overdue for a batch triage pass.

Project Status Meetings anomaly: the same page url seeded into the snapshot on 2026-08-31 as 'Project Status -- Aug 4/26' (dated 2026-08-04) now shows Name 'Project Status -- Sep 1/26' and Date 2026-09-01 -- the row was edited in place rather than a new page being created for the new meeting. Emitted as meeting_logged this run based on the substantive date/name change, but this breaks the documented 'identify meetings by page url' dedupe invariant (same url, different meeting content) and needs a look -- future meetings using this reuse pattern won't be caught by url-based dedupe.
Meeting Summary is still empty on the latest Project Status meeting row -- suggest running the meeting-processor skill on https://app.notion.com/3ac596a4505f81f39a92ce0b21a4ef0b.

SQL-mode has_more read false on the first Tactical Tasks List pull (ORDER BY createdTime ASC LIMIT 100, returned exactly 100 rows) despite a separate COUNT(*) showing 152 actual open rows -- has_more under-reported real truncation. Worked around this run with a second query (createdTime > last-seen-cutoff) to capture the remaining 52 rows; any single-query pull trusting has_more:false on a >100-row source risks silently missing rows. Worth adding to notion-ingest-sources.json's trap notes.

platform-settings/notion-ingest-sources.json's qa_work_orders.select_columns still lists 'Budget Expense' and 'Description To Send' rather than the live names 'Budget Expense ($$ Payout)' and 'Description To Send (To Contractor)' (first flagged 2026-08-14, still uncorrected). Queries were adjusted live again this run.
